# RankEmpire

> RankEmpire is a US SEO agency for local businesses, e-commerce brands and SaaS companies, led by founder Gaurav Kapoor. It runs search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) as one program: a free audit, a 90-day roadmap, one senior strategist per account, month-to-month plans after onboarding, and results published from Google Search Console.

Contact: hello@rankempire.com. Website: https://www.rankempire.us. Results: https://www.rankempire.us/case-studies/ (verified Search Console reports). Pricing: https://www.rankempire.us/seo-packages/.

## Services
- [All SEO services](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-services/): RankEmpire offers local SEO, e-commerce SEO, SaaS and B2B SEO, technical SEO, SEO audits, Google Business Profile optimization, content SEO, link building, keyword research, competitor analysis, national, enterprise and international SEO, plus answer engine (AEO) and generative engine (GEO) optimization for AI search. Every plan includes an audit, a 90-day roadmap and monthly reporting.
- [Local SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/local-seo/): Local SEO puts a business in the Google map pack and local organic results for searches near its service area. It includes Google Business Profile optimization, consistent citations, a review system, service and area pages, local links and grid-based rank tracking across the whole area rather than from one address. RankEmpire runs it as a 90-day roadmap, month to month after onboarding.
- [Google Business Profile SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/google-business-profile-seo/): Google Business Profile optimization is the work of making your profile the most relevant and trusted result for local searches: the right primary and secondary categories, complete services and attributes, regular photos and posts, a steady flow of reviews with replies, answered Q&A and accurate hours. It is the single biggest lever in the Google map pack, and RankEmpire manages it monthly as part of every local plan.
- [E-commerce SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/ecommerce-seo/): E-commerce SEO grows organic revenue by making category and product pages rank for buying searches. The work includes category page optimization, product content and structured data, control of faceted navigation and duplicate URLs, site speed, buying guides and internal linking between collections. RankEmpire reports e-commerce programs in organic revenue per category, not just traffic.
- [SaaS SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/saas-seo/): SaaS SEO builds pipeline from organic search by ranking for bottom-funnel searches first: comparison and alternative pages, integration pages, use-case and feature pages, then topical authority content that feeds them. Because software buyers research for weeks, the program maps content to each stage and reports trials, demos and signups rather than sessions. RankEmpire runs SaaS SEO for B2B software teams.
- [B2B SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/b2b-seo/): B2B SEO targets fewer, higher-value searches made by buying committees over long sales cycles, so it prioritizes bottom-funnel pages (pricing, comparisons, integrations, use cases), account-level content and attribution from organic search to closed deals rather than raw traffic. RankEmpire builds B2B programs around pipeline: pages mapped to each stage of the buying process, reported in leads and revenue.
- [Technical SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/technical-seo/): Technical SEO makes sure search engines can crawl, render, index and quickly load a website. It covers crawl budget, indexation control, canonicals and duplicates, Core Web Vitals, structured data, JavaScript rendering, site architecture and migrations. RankEmpire starts every program with a technical audit because the foundation decides what content and links can achieve.
- [SEO audit](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-audit/): A RankEmpire SEO audit covers technical health (crawling, indexing, speed, structured data), content and keyword gaps, backlinks, local SEO signals and competitors, and ends with a prioritized 90-day action plan rather than a list of warnings. The initial audit is free, delivered within two business days, and becomes the roadmap if you go ahead.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.rankempire.us/aeo/): Answer engine optimization (AEO) is the practice of structuring pages so that search engines, voice assistants and AI answer boxes can lift a direct answer from them. It focuses on the passage, not the page: a clear question as the heading, a complete answer in the first two sentences, and schema that labels what the block is. RankEmpire runs AEO inside every SEO plan, tracked as featured snippets, People Also Ask results and AI Overview citations you own.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.rankempire.us/geo/): Generative engine optimization (GEO) is the work of getting a brand retrieved, trusted and cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Mode. Those engines synthesize answers from several sources, so GEO concentrates on entity clarity, original and quotable facts, brand mentions across the web, freshness and open access for AI crawlers. RankEmpire tracks share of citations per prompt alongside classic rankings.
- [Content SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/content-seo/): Content SEO is the planning, writing and maintenance of pages that match real search demand and build topical authority. It covers keyword-to-page mapping, topic clusters, SEO writing that answers the question first, refreshes of ageing pages and an editorial calendar tied to business goals. RankEmpire's content work is measured in rankings, citations in AI answers and leads, not word counts.
- [Link building](https://www.rankempire.us/link-building/): RankEmpire earns editorial backlinks from real, relevant websites through outreach, digital PR, guest contributions, original data and linkable assets. We do not buy links, use private blog networks or submit to bulk directories, because those get sites filtered. Link building is reported as referring domains and brand mentions, which also drive citations in AI answers.
- [Keyword research](https://www.rankempire.us/keyword-research/): Good keyword research delivers a map, not a list: every search worth winning sorted by intent (learn, compare, buy, find locally), clustered by topic, scored for difficulty and assigned to the one page that should rank for it. RankEmpire's keyword research becomes the content and page plan for the whole program, so no two pages compete for the same search.
- [On-page SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/on-page-seo/): On-page SEO aligns each page with the search it should win: a title and heading that match intent, content that answers the question first, internal links from related pages, optimized images and structured data. It is the part of SEO fully under your control. RankEmpire applies it page by page from a keyword-to-page map, so every page has one clear job.
- [Off-page SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/off-page-seo/): Off-page SEO is everything outside your own website that builds authority and trust: editorial backlinks, brand mentions, digital PR, business citations, reviews and reputation signals. Search engines and AI assistants both weigh how often and where a brand appears across the web. RankEmpire earns these signals through outreach and PR rather than purchased links.
- [Competitor SEO analysis](https://www.rankempire.us/competitor-seo-analysis/): A competitor SEO analysis reverse-engineers why rivals rank: the keywords they win, the pages that earn their traffic, the backlinks and brand mentions behind their authority, and the technical advantages in speed and structure. RankEmpire turns that into a gap report and a prioritized plan showing which keywords, pages and links will close the distance fastest.
- [National SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/national-seo/): National SEO targets competitive, non-local searches across an entire country, where rankings are decided by authority, content depth and technical strength rather than proximity. The work combines competitive keyword strategy, authority building through links and mentions, scalable content and technical SEO. RankEmpire builds national programs for brands that sell everywhere in the US.
- [Enterprise SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/enterprise-seo/): Enterprise SEO deals with scale and governance: tens of thousands of URLs, multiple teams and markets, legacy platforms and release cycles that affect crawling and indexing. The work centers on technical SEO at scale, templates that fix thousands of pages at once, international structure, programmatic content with real uniqueness and reporting that executives can act on. RankEmpire runs enterprise programs with a named senior strategist.
- [International SEO](https://www.rankempire.us/international-seo/): International SEO makes a website rank correctly in multiple countries and languages. It includes market and keyword research per country, choosing between subdomains, subfolders and country domains, hreflang tags so each market sees the right version, localization rather than translation, and link building in each target market. RankEmpire supports US brands expanding abroad and international brands entering the US.
- [SEO consulting](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-consulting/): SEO consulting fits teams that have in-house capacity but need expert direction: strategy sessions, audits, migration and redesign planning, training for writers and developers, and an advisor on call. Instead of doing the work for you, RankEmpire sets the plan, reviews what your team ships and corrects course monthly.
- [About the SEO company](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-company/): RankEmpire is a US-focused SEO company for local businesses, e-commerce brands and SaaS companies, led personally by founder Gaurav Kapoor. Every account gets one senior strategist, a free audit, a 90-day roadmap, month-to-month plans after onboarding, plain-English reporting and results published from Google Search Console rather than mockups.

## Industry playbooks (54)
- [SEO for Cleaning Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-cleaning/): Cleaning company SEO wins the searches people make when they need a house, office or move-out clean, which are mostly local and mobile.
- [SEO for Electricians](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-electricians/): Electrician SEO captures both emergency calls and planned work like panel upgrades, EV chargers and rewiring.
- [SEO for Fencing Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-fencing-companies/): Fencing SEO is seasonal and material-driven: homeowners search by fence type (wood, vinyl, chain link, aluminum) and by purpose (privacy, pool, pet).
- [SEO for Flooring Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-flooring-companies/): Flooring SEO targets shoppers comparing hardwood, LVP, tile, carpet and refinishing over weeks, plus installers searched locally.
- [SEO for General Contractors](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-general-contractors/): General contractor SEO must separate remodels, additions, kitchens, bathrooms and new builds into their own pages, because homeowners search for the project, not the contractor type.
- [SEO for HVAC Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-hvac/): HVAC SEO wins two kinds of searches: emergency repair when a system fails, decided in the map pack within minutes, and replacement or installation, researched over weeks.
- [SEO for Landscaping Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-landscaping/): Landscaping SEO covers recurring maintenance searches and one-time design and hardscape projects, each with different intent.
- [SEO for Locksmiths](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-locksmiths/): Locksmith SEO is dominated by urgent lockout searches and heavily affected by spam listings in the map pack.
- [SEO for Moving Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-movers/): Moving company SEO targets people planning a move weeks ahead and comparing quotes, so it combines local map pack visibility with pages for local, long-distance, commercial and specialty moves and transparent pricing information.
- [SEO for Painting Contractors](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-painters/): Painting SEO separates interior, exterior, cabinet and commercial painting into their own pages, because each is a different search with different pricing.
- [SEO for Pest Control Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-pest-control/): Pest control SEO targets pest-specific searches (termites, bed bugs, rodents, mosquitoes) that spike by season, plus recurring service plans.
- [SEO for Plumbers](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-plumbers/): Plumber SEO wins emergency searches in the map pack and planned work like water heaters, repiping and remodels through detailed service pages.
- [SEO for Pool Service Companies](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-pool-service-companies/): Pool service SEO covers weekly maintenance plans, repairs, equipment installs and openings and closings, with demand concentrated in spring and summer.

- [SEO for Doctors and Medical Practices](https://www.rankempire.us/seo-for-doctors/): Medical practice SEO brings in patients searching by specialty, condition, procedure and insurance accepted.
